app: the care home conformance app: one app whose screens a care home's staff would use, its component bench and refusal routes as the test infrastructure they are, run under a closed set of host variants; every browser test of the framework runs on one of its screens

areas.care: a screen a care home's staff uses; it holds only what a user does
areas.bench: the component bench: the object-surface variations of the custom components, which are no business behavior
areas.refusals: one route per refusal where the view renders, each a deliberately broken view whose error the test reads

harness.seed: writes the test's own data under its world key, through the world contract's typed builders: its records, the answers its endpoints script, and the sampler's decision for a request
harness.gate: holds a named TLA+ action of the test's world until the test releases it; the test waits until the harness reports it held
harness.push: makes the server push a stream or hub message to the test's world and reports how many connections it reached; the harness also reports the world's open connections of a stream or hub, which a test waits on before it pushes
harness.drop: ends the test's stream or hub connection and holds the browser's next one until reopen, reporting it held
harness.refuse: answers each of the test's stream or hub connections 503 until reopen, ending an open one first, and reports each connection it refuses; a stream gives up at its next connection and a hub's start or reconnection fails
harness.reopen: lets the held next connection in, or ends a refusal
harness.restart: the test app's host script, in the layout of every screen, destroys a component's object and puts a new one on the same element when the harness tells it through the world's own channel, as the component's host does, and reports it done; no page holds a control for it
harness.clock: Playwright's Page.Clock, for every page timer: a plan's waits and the hub client's start and reconnection waits; a stream's reconnection runs on the browser's own timer, outside the clock, after the retry: the harness's stream endpoints write
harness.gc: Playwright's Page.RequestGCAsync, confirmed by the page's own weak hold

partKinds.native: a plain element or a hand-written control in the view's markup: the core reaches an element by id (M5.N1), markup raises an app event from it (M1.D3), and a native form sends its hand-written controls (D9.15); never a framework input, which a consumer renders (M7.N2)
partKinds.conformance: a declaration of the conformance library, spec/Reference/native.json, named by the part's declares
partKinds.fusion: a Syncfusion component through its Fusion slice; never a part of a core module's test
partKinds.nativeSlice: a Native slice's component (NativeDrawer, NativeToast, NativeConfirm, NativeLoader, NativeActionLink, NativeCheckList and the rest)
partKinds.endpoint: a server endpoint the screen's requests reach
partKinds.partial: a partial rendered with the page that carries its own plan, composed by PlanId
partKinds.validator: a ReactiveValidator<T> registered through DI, whose rules the plan carries by component ID
